title.zh: 规定科学研究激励措施并为自然科学研究中心运作提供资金，为此修订第3887号共和国法第5条与第8条的法案
title.en: An Act Providing Incentives for Science Research and Funds for the Operation of the Natural Science Research Center, Amending for the Purpose Sections Five and Eight of Republic Act Numbered Three Thousand Eight Hundred and Eighty-Seven
title.orig: An Act Providing Incentives for Science Research and Funds for the Operation of the Natural Science Research Center, Amending for the Purpose Sections Five and Eight of Republic Act Numbered Three Thousand Eight Hundred and Eighty-Seven

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_6069_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Section five of Republic Act Numbered Three thousand eight hundred and eighty-seven is hereby amended by inserting after sub-paragraph (f) thereof a new sub-paragraph to be known as sub-paragraph (g) which shall read as follows:"(g) To provide additional incentives, through grants and honoraria, to scholars and researchers in science at rates fixed by the Board of Regents, any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding."

Section eight of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 8. To provide the facilities and financial support for the Center, the sum of two million pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated from the funds of the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the capital and operating requirements of the Center for the current fiscal year. Starting with fiscal year nineteen hundred seventy-one the sum of three hundred thousand pesos shall be added to the annual appropriations of the University of the Philippines for the operation and maintenance of the Center."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved. August 4, 1969.
